title: North-West Frontier Province Provincial Assembly Powers Immunities And Privileges Amendment Act 2005

sections.shortTitle: North-West Frontier Province Provincial Assembly Powers Immunities And Privileges Amendment Act 2005
sections.description:
Short title and commencement

ACT VII OF 2005
ACT VII OF 2005
North-West Frontier Province Provincial Assembly (Powers Immunities And
Privileges) (Amendment) Act 2005
An Act to amend the North-West Frontier
Province Provincial Assembly (Powers, Immunities and Privileges) Act, 1988
[Gazette of N.-W.F.P. Extraordinary, 16th February,
2005]
It
is hereby enacted as follows:‑
1. Short title and commencement.---(1) This
Act may be called the North-West Frontier Province Provincial Assembly (Powers,
Immunities and Privileges) (Amendment) Act, 2005.
(2)
It shall come into. force at once.

It

2. Amendment of section 25 of the N.-W.F.P. Act No.IX of 1988.--In the North-West Frontier Province Provincial
Assembly (Powers, Immunities and Privileges) Act, 1988 (N.-W.F.P. Act No.IX of
1988) hereinafter referred to as the said Act, in section 25, in column No.2 of
the schedule, in serial No.28, the words "in the precincts of the Assembly"
shall be deleted.
